result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. The full `mvn -o test` run passes. I didn't add a test for the T-1 to T-5 example, so the new ordering isn't covered by a test of its own.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `highestPriorityFirst()` sort that the sales rep's open-ticket list uses, and I updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded as before.

Only `RegionManagerService` calls this method, so nothing else changes order.
